1.english_reference: The word of the LORD came again unto me

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ
traditions.VUL: Et factus est sermo Dómini ad me ,
traditions.KJV: The word of the LORD came again unto me ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: λέγων
traditions.VUL: dicens :
traditions.KJV: saying ,

2.english_reference: Son of man , say unto the prince of Tyrus

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אָדָ֡ם אֱמֹר֩ לִ נְגִ֨יד צֹ֜ר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ σύ , υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου , εἰπὸν τῷ ἄρχοντι Τύρου
traditions.VUL: Fili hóminis , dic príncipi Tyri :
traditions.KJV: Son of man , say unto the prince of Tyrus ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהֹוִ֗ה
traditions.LXX: Τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

2.english_reference: Because thine heart [ is ] lifted up

traditions.WLC: יַ֣עַן גָּבַ֤הּ לִבְּ ךָ֙
traditions.LXX: Ἀνθ᾽ οὗ ὑψώθη σου ἡ καρδία ,
traditions.VUL: Eo quod elevátum est cor tuum ,
traditions.KJV: Because thine heart [ is ] lifted up ,

2.english_reference: and thou hast said , I [ am ] a God

traditions.WLC: וַ תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֵ֣ל אָ֔נִי
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπας θεός εἰμι ἐγώ ,
traditions.VUL: et dixísti : Deus ego sum ,
traditions.KJV: and thou hast said , I [ am ] a God ,

2.english_reference: I sit [ in ] the seat of God , in the midst of the seas

traditions.WLC: מוֹשַׁ֧ב אֱלֹהִ֛ים יָשַׁ֖בְתִּי בְּ לֵ֣ב יַמִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: κατοικίαν Θεοῦ κατοίκηκα ἐν καρδίᾳ θαλάσσης ,
traditions.VUL: et in cáthedra Dei sedi in corde maris :
traditions.KJV: I sit [ in ] the seat of God , in the midst of the seas ;

2.english_reference: yet thou [ art ] a man , and not God

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֤ה אָדָם֙ וְֽ לֹא אֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: σὺ δὲ εἶ ἄνθρωπος καὶ οὐ θεός ,
traditions.VUL: cum sis homo , et non Deus ,
traditions.KJV: yet thou [ art ] a man , and not God ,

2.english_reference: though thou set thine heart as the heart of God

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּתֵּ֥ן לִבְּ ךָ֖ כְּ לֵ֥ב אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκας τὴν καρδίαν σου ὡς καρδίαν θεοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et dedísti cor tuum quasi cor Dei .
traditions.KJV: though thou set thine heart as the heart of God :

3.english_reference: Behold , thou [ art ] wiser than Daniel

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֥ה חָכָ֛ם אַתָּ֖ה מ דנאל
traditions.LXX: μὴ σοφώτερος εἶ σὺ τοῦ Δανιήλ ;
traditions.VUL: Ecce sapiéntior es tu Daniéle :
traditions.KJV: Behold , thou [ art ] wiser than Daniel ;

3.english_reference: there is no secret that they can hide from thee

traditions.WLC: כָּל סָת֖וּם לֹ֥א עֲמָמֽוּ ךָ
traditions.LXX: σοφοὶ οὐκ ἐπαίδευσάν σε τῇ ἐπιστήμῃ αὐτῶν ;
traditions.VUL: omne secrétum non est abscónditum a te .
traditions.KJV: there is no secret that they can hide from thee :

4.english_reference: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches

traditions.WLC: בְּ חָכְמָֽתְ ךָ֙ וּ בִ תְבוּנָ֣תְ ךָ֔ עָשִׂ֥יתָ לְּ ךָ֖ חָ֑יִל
traditions.LXX: μὴ ἐν τῇ ἐπιστήμῃ σου ἢ τῇ φρονήσει σου ἐποίησας σεαυτῷ δύναμιν
traditions.VUL: In sapiéntia et prudéntia tua fecísti tibi fortitúdinem :
traditions.KJV: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches ,

4.english_reference: and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures

traditions.WLC: וַ תַּ֛עַשׂ זָהָ֥ב וָ כֶ֖סֶף בְּ אוֹצְרוֹתֶֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ χρυσίον καὶ ἀργύριον ἐν τοῖς θησαυροῖς σου ;
traditions.VUL: et acquisísti aurum , et argéntum in thesáuris tuis .
traditions.KJV: and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures :

5.english_reference: By thy great wisdom [ and ] by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches

traditions.WLC: בְּ רֹ֧ב חָכְמָתְ ךָ֛ בִּ רְכֻלָּתְ ךָ֖ הִרְבִּ֣יתָ חֵילֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῇ πολλῇ ἐπιστήμῃ σου καὶ ἐμπορίᾳ ἐπλήθυνας δύναμίν σου ,
traditions.VUL: In multitúdine sapiéntiæ tuæ , et in negotiatióne tua multiplicásti tibi fortitúdinem ,
traditions.KJV: By thy great wisdom [ and ] by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches ,

5.english_reference: and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּגְבַּ֥הּ לְבָבְ ךָ֖ בְּ חֵילֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ὑψώθη ἡ καρδία σου ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου .
traditions.VUL: et elevátum est cor tuum in róbore tuo .
traditions.KJV: and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches :

6.english_reference: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֕ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֑ה
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Proptérea hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ;

6.english_reference: Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God

traditions.WLC: יַ֛עַן תִּתְּ ךָ֥ אֶת לְבָבְ ךָ֖ כְּ לֵ֥ב אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: Ἐπειδὴ δέδωκας τὴν καρδίαν σου ὡς καρδίαν θεοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Eo quod elevátum est cor tuum quasi cor Dei :
traditions.KJV: Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God ;

7.english_reference: Behold , therefore I will bring strangers upon thee , the terrible of the nations

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן הִנְ נִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא עָלֶ֨י ךָ֙ זָרִ֔ים עָרִיצֵ֖י גּוֹיִ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἀντὶ τούτου ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ἐπὶ σὲ ἀλλοτρίους λοιμοὺς ἀπὸ ἐθνῶν ,
traditions.VUL: idcírco ecce ego addúcam super te aliénos , robustíssimos géntium :
traditions.KJV: Behold , therefore I will bring strangers upon thee , the terrible of the nations :

7.english_reference: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵרִ֤יקוּ חַרְבוֹתָ ם֙ עַל יְפִ֣י חָכְמָתֶ֔ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκκενώσουσιν τὰς μαχαίρας αὐτῶν ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ κάλλος τῆς ἐπιστήμης σου ,
traditions.VUL: et nudábunt gládios suos super pulchritúdinem sapiéntiæ tuæ ,
traditions.KJV: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom ,

7.english_reference: and they shall defile thy brightness

traditions.WLC: וְ חִלְּל֖וּ יִפְעָתֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ στρώσουσιν τὸ κάλλος σου εἰς ἀπώλειαν ,
traditions.VUL: et pólluent decórem tuum .
traditions.KJV: and they shall defile thy brightness .

8.english_reference: They shall bring thee down to the pit

traditions.WLC: לַ שַּׁ֖חַת יֽוֹרִד֑וּ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ καταβιβάσουσίν σε ,
traditions.VUL: Interfícient , et détrahent te :
traditions.KJV: They shall bring thee down to the pit ,

8.english_reference: and thou shalt die the deaths of [ them that are ] slain in the midst of the seas

traditions.WLC: וָ מַ֛תָּה מְמוֹתֵ֥י חָלָ֖ל בְּ לֵ֥ב יַמִּֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀποθανῇ θανάτῳ τραυματιῶν ἐν καρδίᾳ θαλάσσης .
traditions.VUL: et moriéris in intéritu occisórum in corde maris .
traditions.KJV: and thou shalt die the deaths of [ them that are ] slain in the midst of the seas .

9.english_reference: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee , I [ am ] God ?

traditions.WLC: הֶ אָמֹ֤ר תֹּאמַר֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אָ֔נִי לִ פְנֵ֖י הֹֽרְגֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: μὴ λέγων ἐρεῖς Θεός εἰμι ἐγώ , ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀναιρούντων σε ;
traditions.VUL: Numquid dicens loquéris : Deus ego sum , coram interficiéntibus te :
traditions.KJV: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee , I [ am ] God ?

9.english_reference: but thou [ shalt be ] a man , and no God , in the hand of him that slayeth thee

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֥ה אָדָ֛ם וְ לֹא אֵ֖ל בְּ יַ֥ד מְחַלְלֶֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: σὺ δὲ εἶ ἄνθρωπος καὶ οὐ θεός .
traditions.VUL: cum sis homo , et non Deus , in manu occidéntium te ?
traditions.KJV: but thou [ shalt be ] a man , and no God , in the hand of him that slayeth thee .

10.english_reference: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers

traditions.WLC: מוֹתֵ֧י עֲרֵלִ֛ים תָּמ֖וּת בְּ יַד זָרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: ἐν πλήθει ἀπεριτμήτων ἀπολῇ ἐν χερσὶν ἀλλοτρίων ,
traditions.VUL: Morte incircumcisórum moriéris in manu alienórum :
traditions.KJV: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers :

10.english_reference: for I have spoken [ it ] , saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהוִֽה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐλάλησα , λέγει Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: quia ego locútus sum , ait Dóminus Deus .
traditions.KJV: for I have spoken [ it ] , saith the Lord GOD .

11.english_reference: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factus est sermo Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.VUL: Fili hóminis leva planctum super regem Tyri :

12.english_reference: Son of man , take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus ,

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם שָׂ֥א קִינָ֖ה עַל מֶ֣לֶךְ צ֑וֹר
traditions.LXX: Υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου , λάβε θρῆνον ἐπὶ τὸν ἄρχοντα Τύρου
traditions.KJV: Son of man , take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus ,

12.english_reference: and say unto him , Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַ֣רְתָּ לּ֗ וֹ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰπὸν αὐτῷ Τάδε λέγει κύριος Κύριος
traditions.VUL: et dices ei : Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: and say unto him , Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

12.english_reference: Thou sealest up the sum , full of wisdom , and perfect in beauty .

traditions.WLC: אַתָּה֙ חוֹתֵ֣ם תָּכְנִ֔ית מָלֵ֥א חָכְמָ֖ה וּ כְלִ֥יל יֹֽפִי
traditions.LXX: Σὺ ἀποσφράγισμα ὁμοιώσεως καὶ στέφανος κάλλους
traditions.VUL: Tu signáculum similitúdinis , plenus sapiéntia , et perféctus decóre ,
traditions.KJV: Thou sealest up the sum , full of wisdom , and perfect in beauty .

13.english_reference: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God ;

traditions.WLC: בְּ עֵ֨דֶן גַּן אֱלֹהִ֜ים הָיִ֗יתָ
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῇ τρυφῇ τοῦ παραδείσου τοῦ θεοῦ ἐγενήθης .
traditions.VUL: in delíciis paradísi Dei fuísti :
traditions.KJV: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God ;

13.english_reference: every precious stone [ was ] thy covering , the sardius , topaz , and the diamond , the beryl , the onyx , and the jasper , the sapphire , the emerald , and the carbuncle , and gold :

traditions.WLC: כָּל אֶ֨בֶן יְקָרָ֤ה מְסֻכָתֶ֨ ךָ֙ אֹ֣דֶם פִּטְדָ֞ה וְ יָהֲלֹ֗ם תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֨הַם֙ וְ יָ֣שְׁפֵ֔ה סַפִּ֣יר נֹ֔פֶךְ וּ בָרְקַ֖ת וְ זָהָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: πᾶν λίθον χρηστὸν ἐνδέδεσαι , σάρδιον καὶ τοπάζιον καὶ σμάραγδον , καὶ ἄνθρακα καὶ σάπφειρον καὶ ἴασπιν , καὶ ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον , καὶ λιγύριον καὶ ἀχάτην καὶ ἀμέθυστον , καὶ χρυσόλιθον καὶ βηρύλλιον καὶ ὀνύχιον ,
traditions.VUL: omnis lapis pretiósus operiméntum tuum : sárdius , topázius , et iaspis , chrysólithus , et onyx , et berýllus , sapphírus , et carbúnculus , et smarágdus : aurum
traditions.KJV: every precious stone [ was ] thy covering , the sardius , topaz , and the diamond , the beryl , the onyx , and the jasper , the sapphire , the emerald , and the carbuncle , and gold :

13.english_reference: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created .

traditions.WLC: מְלֶ֨אכֶת תֻּפֶּ֤י ךָ וּ נְקָבֶ֨י ךָ֙ בָּ֔ ךְ בְּ י֥וֹם הִבָּרַאֲ ךָ֖ כּוֹנָֽנוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ χρυσίου ἐνέπλησας τοὺς θησαυρούς σου καὶ τὰς ἀποθήκας σου ἐν σοί .
traditions.VUL: opus decóris tui : et forámina tua in die , qua cónditus es , præparáta sunt .
traditions.KJV: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created .

14.english_reference: Thou [ art ] the anointed cherub that covereth ;

traditions.WLC: אַ֨תְּ כְּר֔וּב מִמְשַׁ֖ח הַ סּוֹכֵ֑ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἀφ᾽ ἧς ἡμέρας ἐκτίσθης σὺ μετὰ τοῦ χερούβ ,
traditions.VUL: Tu cherub exténtus , et prótegens ,
traditions.KJV: Thou [ art ] the anointed cherub that covereth ;

14.english_reference: and I have set thee [ so ] : thou wast upon the holy mountain of God ;

traditions.WLC: וּ נְתַתִּ֗י ךָ בְּ הַ֨ר קֹ֤דֶשׁ אֱלֹהִים֙ הָיִ֔יתָ
traditions.LXX: ἔθηκά σε ἐν ὄρει ἁγίῳ θεοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et pósui te in monte sancto Dei ,
traditions.KJV: and I have set thee [ so ] : thou wast upon the holy mountain of God ;

14.english_reference: thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire .

traditions.WLC: בְּ ת֥וֹךְ אַבְנֵי אֵ֖שׁ הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ
traditions.LXX: ἐγενήθης ἐν μέσῳ λίθων πυρίνων ,
traditions.VUL: in médio lápidum ignitórum ambulásti .
traditions.KJV: thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire .

15.english_reference: Thou [ wast ] perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created ,

traditions.WLC: תָּמִ֤ים אַתָּה֙ בִּ דְרָכֶ֔י ךָ מִ יּ֖וֹם הִבָּֽרְאָ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐγενήθης ἄμωμος σὺ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις σου , ἀφ᾽ ἧς ἡμέρας σὺ ἐκτίσθης
traditions.VUL: Perféctus in viis tuis a die conditiónis tuæ ,
traditions.KJV: Thou [ wast ] perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created ,

15.english_reference: till iniquity was found in thee .

traditions.WLC: עַד נִמְצָ֥א עַוְלָ֖תָ ה בָּֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἕως εὑρέθη τὰ ἀδικήματα ἐν σοί .
traditions.VUL: donec invénta est iníquitas in te .
traditions.KJV: till iniquity was found in thee .

16.english_reference: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence , and thou hast sinned :

traditions.WLC: בְּ רֹ֣ב רְכֻלָּתְ ךָ֗ מָל֧וּ תוֹכְ ךָ֛ חָמָ֖ס וַֽ תֶּחֱטָ֑א
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ πλήθους τῆς ἐμπορίας σου ἔπλησας τὰ ταμιεῖά σου ἀνομίας , καὶ ἥμαρτες
traditions.VUL: In multitúdine negotiatiónis tuæ repléta sunt interióra tua iniquitáte , et peccásti :
traditions.KJV: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence , and thou hast sinned :

16.english_reference: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God :

traditions.WLC: וָ אֶחַלֶּלְ ךָ֩ מֵ הַ֨ר אֱלֹהִ֤ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐτραυματίσθης ἀπὸ ὄρους τοῦ θεοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et eiéci te de monte Dei ,
traditions.KJV: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God :

16.english_reference: and I will destroy thee , O covering cherub , from the midst of the stones of fire .

traditions.WLC: וָֽ אַבֶּדְ ךָ֙ כְּר֣וּב הַ סֹּכֵ֔ךְ מִ תּ֖וֹךְ אַבְנֵי אֵֽשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤγαγέν σε τὸ χεροὺβ ἐκ μέσου λίθων πυρίνων .
traditions.VUL: et perdídidi te o cherub prótegens , de médio lápidum ignitórum .
traditions.KJV: and I will destroy thee , O covering cherub , from the midst of the stones of fire .

17.english_reference: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty ,

traditions.LXX: ὑψώθη ἡ καρδία σου ἐπὶ τῷ κάλλει σου ,
traditions.VUL: Et elevátum est cor tuum in decóre tuo :
traditions.KJV: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty ,

17.english_reference: thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness :

traditions.WLC: שִׁחַ֥תָּ חָכְמָתְ ךָ֖ עַל יִפְעָתֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: διεφθάρη ἡ ἐπιστήμη σου μετὰ τοῦ κάλλους σου ·
traditions.VUL: perdidísti sapiéntiam tuam in decóre tuo ,
traditions.KJV: thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness :

17.english_reference: I will cast thee to the ground ,

traditions.WLC: עַל אֶ֣רֶץ הִשְׁלַכְתִּ֗י ךָ
traditions.LXX: διὰ πλῆθος ἁμαρτιῶν σου ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἔρριψά σε ,
traditions.VUL: in terram proiéci te :
traditions.KJV: I will cast thee to the ground ,

17.english_reference: I will lay thee before kings , that they may behold thee .

traditions.WLC: לִ פְנֵ֧י מְלָכִ֛ים נְתַתִּ֖י ךָ לְ רַ֥אֲוָה בָֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐναντίον βασιλέων ἔδωκά σε παραδειγματισθῆναι .
traditions.VUL: ante fáciem regum dedi te ut cérnerent te .
traditions.KJV: I will lay thee before kings , that they may behold thee .

18.english_reference: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities , by the iniquity of thy traffick ;

traditions.WLC: מֵ רֹ֣ב עֲוֺנֶ֗י ךָ בְּ עֶ֨וֶל֙ רְכֻלָּ֣תְ ךָ֔ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ מִקְדָּשֶׁ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: διὰ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν σου καὶ τῶν ἀδικιῶν τῆς ἐμπορίας σου ἐβεβήλωσα τὰ ἱερά σου ,
traditions.VUL: In multitúdine iniquitátum tuárum , et iniquitáte negotiatiónis tuæ polluísti sanctificatiónem tuam :
traditions.KJV: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities , by the iniquity of thy traffick ;

18.english_reference: therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee , it shall devour thee ,

traditions.WLC: וָֽ אוֹצִא אֵ֤שׁ מִ תּֽוֹכְ ךָ֙ הִ֣יא אֲכָלַ֔תְ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξάξω πῦρ ἐκ μέσου σου , τοῦτο καταφάγεταί σε ·
traditions.VUL: prodúcam ergo ignem de médio tui , qui cómedat te ,
traditions.KJV: therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee , it shall devour thee ,

18.english_reference: and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee .

traditions.WLC: וָ אֶתֶּנְ ךָ֤ לְ אֵ֨פֶר֙ עַל הָ אָ֔רֶץ לְ עֵינֵ֖י כָּל רֹאֶֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ δώσω σε σποδὸν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς σου ἐναντίον πάντων τῶν ὁρώντων σε .
traditions.VUL: et dabo te in cínerem super terram , in conspéctu ómnium vidéntium te .
traditions.KJV: and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee .

19.english_reference: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee :

traditions.WLC: כָּל יוֹדְעֶ֨י ךָ֙ בָּֽ עַמִּ֔ים שָׁמְמ֖וּ עָלֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐπιστάμενοί σε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν στενάξουσιν ἐπὶ σέ ·
traditions.VUL: Omnes , qui víderint te in géntibus , obstupéscent super te :
traditions.KJV: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee :

19.english_reference: thou shalt be a terror , and never [ shalt ] thou [ be ] any more .

traditions.WLC: בַּלָּה֣וֹת הָיִ֔יתָ וְ אֵינְ ךָ֖ עַד עוֹלָֽם
traditions.LXX: ἀπωλία ἐγένου , καὶ οὐχ ὑπάρξεις ἔτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα .
traditions.VUL: níhili factus es , et non eris in perpétuum .
traditions.KJV: thou shalt be a terror , and never [ shalt ] thou [ be ] any more .

20.english_reference: Again the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factus est sermo Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Again the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם
traditions.LXX: Υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ,
traditions.VUL: Fili hóminis
traditions.KJV: Son of man ,

traditions.WLC: שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖י ךָ אֶל צִיד֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ Σειδῶνα
traditions.VUL: pone fáciem tuam contra Sidónem ,
traditions.KJV: set thy face against Zidon ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנָּבֵ֖א עָלֶֽי הָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ προφήτευσον ἐπ᾽ αὐτὴν .
traditions.VUL: et prophetábis de ea :
traditions.KJV: and prophesy against it ,

22.english_reference: And say , Thus saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַרְתָּ֗ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰπόν Τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: et dices : Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: And say , Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

22.english_reference: Behold , I [ am ] against thee , O Zidon

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֤י עָלַ֨יִ ךְ֙ צִיד֔וֹן
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σέ , Σειδών ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego ad te Sidon ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I [ am ] against thee , O Zidon ;

22.english_reference: and I will be glorified in the midst of thee

traditions.WLC: וְ נִכְבַּדְתִּ֖י בְּ תוֹכֵ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνδοξασθήσομαι ἐν σοί ,
traditions.VUL: et glorificábor in médio tui :
traditions.KJV: and I will be glorified in the midst of thee :

22.english_reference: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְֽ יָדְע֞וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνώσῃ ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: et scient quia ego Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD ,

22.english_reference: when I shall have executed judgments in her

traditions.WLC: בַּ עֲשׂ֥וֹתִ י בָ֛ הּ שְׁפָטִ֖ים
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ ποιῆσαί με ἐν σοὶ κρίματα ,
traditions.VUL: cum fécero in ea iudícia ,
traditions.KJV: when I shall have executed judgments in her ,

22.english_reference: and shall be sanctified in her

traditions.WLC: וְ נִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי בָֽ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἁγιασθήσομαι ἐν σοί .
traditions.VUL: et sanctificátus fúero in ea .
traditions.KJV: and shall be sanctified in her .

23.english_reference: For I will send into her pestilence , and blood into her streets

traditions.WLC: וְ שִׁלַּחְתִּי בָ֞ הּ דֶּ֤בֶר וָ דָם֙ בְּ ח֣וּצוֹתֶ֔י הָ
traditions.LXX: αἷμα καὶ θάνατος ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις σου ,
traditions.VUL: Et immíttam ei pestiléntiam , et sánguinem in platéis eius :
traditions.KJV: For I will send into her pestilence , and blood into her streets ;

23.english_reference: and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side

traditions.WLC: וְ נִפְלַ֤ל חָלָל֙ בְּ תוֹכָ֔ הּ בְּ חֶ֥רֶב עָלֶ֖י הָ מִ סָּבִ֑יב
traditions.LXX: καὶ πεσοῦνται τετραυματισμένοι μαχαίραις ἐν σοὶ περικύκλῳ σου ·
traditions.VUL: et córruent interfécti in médio eius gládio per circúitum :
traditions.KJV: and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side ;

23.english_reference: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνώσονται διότι ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: et scient quia ego Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD .

24.english_reference: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֨ה ע֜וֹד לְ בֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל סִלּ֤וֹן מַמְאִיר֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἔσονται οὐκέτι ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ σκόλοψ πικρίας
traditions.VUL: Et non erit ultra dómui Israel offendículum amaritúdinis ,
traditions.KJV: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel ,

24.english_reference: nor [ any ] grieving thorn of all [ that are ] round about them , that despised them

traditions.WLC: וְ ק֣וֹץ מַכְאִ֔ב מִ כֹּל֙ סְבִ֣יבֹתָ֔ ם הַ שָּׁאטִ֖ים אוֹתָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἄκανθα ὀδύνης ἀπὸ τῶν περικύκλῳ αὐτῶν τῶν ἀτιμασάντων αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: et spina dolórem ínferens úndique per circúitum eórum , qui adversántur eis :
traditions.KJV: nor [ any ] grieving thorn of all [ that are ] round about them , that despised them ;

24.english_reference: and they shall know that I [ am ] the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: וְ יָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהוִֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: et scient quia ego Dóminus Deus .
traditions.KJV: and they shall know that I [ am ] the Lord GOD .

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִה֒
traditions.LXX: τάδε λέγει κύριος Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

25.english_reference: When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered

traditions.WLC: בְּ קַבְּצִ֣ י אֶת בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִן הָֽ עַמִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָפֹ֣צוּ בָ֔ ם
traditions.LXX: Καὶ συνάξω τὸν Ἰσραὴλ ἐκ τῶν ἐθνῶν οὗ διεσκορπίσθησαν ἐκεῖ ,
traditions.VUL: Quando congregávero domum Israel de pópulis , in quibus dispérsi sunt ,
traditions.KJV: When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered ,

25.english_reference: and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen

traditions.WLC: וְ נִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי בָ֖ ם לְ עֵינֵ֣י הַ גּוֹיִ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἁγιασθήσομαι ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐνώπιον τῶν λαῶν καὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν .
traditions.VUL: sanctificábor in eis coram géntibus :
traditions.KJV: and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen ,

25.english_reference: then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob

traditions.WLC: וְ יָֽשְׁבוּ֙ עַל אַדְמָתָ֔ ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לְ עַבְדִּ֥ י לְ יַעֲקֹֽב
traditions.VUL: et habitábunt in terra sua , quam dedi servo meo Iacob .
traditions.KJV: then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob .

26.english_reference: And they shall dwell safely therein

traditions.WLC: וְ יָשְׁב֣וּ עָלֶי הָ֮ לָ בֶטַח֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς αὐτῶν , ἣν δέδωκα τῷ δούλῳ μου Ἰακώβ , καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἐπ᾽ αὐτῆς ἐν ἐλπίδι ,
traditions.VUL: Et habitábunt in ea secúri :
traditions.KJV: And they shall dwell safely therein ,

26.english_reference: and shall build houses , and plant vineyards

traditions.WLC: וּ בָנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְ נָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἰκοδομήσουσιν οἰκίας καὶ φυτεύσουσιν ἀμπελῶνας ,
traditions.VUL: et ædificábunt domos , et plantábunt víneas ,
traditions.KJV: and shall build houses , and plant vineyards ;

26.english_reference: yea , they shall dwell with confidence

traditions.WLC: וְ יָשְׁב֖וּ לָ בֶ֑טַח
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατοικήσουσιν ἐν ἐλπίδι ,
traditions.VUL: et habitábunt confidénter ,
traditions.KJV: yea , they shall dwell with confidence ,

26.english_reference: when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them

traditions.WLC: בַּ עֲשׂוֹתִ֣ י שְׁפָטִ֗ים בְּ כֹ֨ל הַ שָּׁאטִ֤ים אֹתָ ם֙ מִ סְּבִ֣יבוֹתָ֔ ם
traditions.LXX: ὅταν ποιήσω κρίμα ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀτιμάσασιν αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς κύκλῳ αὐτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: cum fécero iudícia in ómnibus , qui adversántur eis per circúitum :
traditions.KJV: when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them ;

26.english_reference: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD their God

traditions.WLC: וְ יָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνώσονται ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι Κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: et scient quia ego Dóminus Deus eórum .
traditions.KJV: and they shall know that I [ am ] the LORD their God .
